records.product_name: Drinking Water (Purified) sold through vending machine
records.exact_reference: FSSR 2.10.9, Beverage Chapter v3 (07.05.2025), PDF printed p.24
established_source_facts: Sold/offered through a decentralised water purification vending machine; not packaged drinking water or natural mineral water.
Purified drinking water must be clear and free of sediments, suspended particles and extraneous matter.
FSSR 2.10.9 expressly references Indian Standard IS 10500 for requirements.
The water vending machine definition excludes installations intended for captive consumption.
positive_additional_evidence: Sales/dispensing photographs and marketing/packaging form.
Treatment flow diagram and dispensing point identified.
Current relevant IS 10500 version and accredited laboratory results at appropriate point of sampling.
No automatic use of the packaged drinking water Tables 1–6 or 2.10.8.
records.forbidden_inference: Do not apply packaged drinking water lead/pesticide limits automatically to vending-machine water. An IS 10500 reference is not itself a verified laboratory report.

records.product_name: Polyols permitted under Appendix-A of FSS(FPS&FA) Regulations,2011 excluding those already standardized
records.exact_reference: FSSR Food Additives Appendix A and FoSCoS category 11.6
established_source_facts: FoSCoS category describes multiple permitted polyols, not one named chemical.
FSSR Appendix A specifies permitted uses by additive/product context rather than one universal polyol purity number.
positive_additional_evidence: Specific polyol name and INS/CAS identity, molecular form, technical grade and producer CoA.
Specific FSSAI ingredient standard or incorporated purity monograph.
Intended FCS finished food and permitted maximum additive use.
records.forbidden_inference: Do not substitute a sorbitol, erythritol, xylitol or maltitol monograph for the entire 11.6 category.

records.exact_reference: FoSCoS Food Additives category 99.1; FSSAI non-specified application status (11.11.2025)
established_source_facts: Sajji Khar appears as a FoSCoS product identity.
FSSAI closed/withdrawn application records mentioning Sajji Khar/Papad cannot be interpreted as an approved general standard.
positive_additional_evidence: Manufacturer's exact constituent profile, alkali source, grade, intended use and food-category applicability.
Locate any current notified FSSAI individual compositional/purity standard or confirm product-specific route.
Confirm current legal status, not merely previous application titles.
records.forbidden_inference: Neither a FoSCoS directory row nor a closed/withdrawn application is proof of product-wide regulatory approval.

records.product_name: Additives permitted under Appendix-A of FSS (FPS&FA) Regulations, 2011 and other food safety standards regulations excluding those already standardized and additives of Nutraceutical Regulations
records.exact_reference: FSSR Appendix A and FoSCoS food-additive catch-all category 99.1
established_source_facts: FoSCoS route covers multiple permitted additives across food standards.
A food-category permission cannot establish purity specifications of an unidentified additive.
positive_additional_evidence: Exact additive INS/CAS and legal name.
Current product-specific FSSR chapter/Appendix A limit and applicable food category.
Relevant individual purity specifications and any restrictions.
records.forbidden_inference: Do not assign all permitted colours, preservatives, acidity regulators or emulsifiers a single heavy-metal limit.

records.product_name: Additives VA-VF of Nutraceutical Regulations excluding those already standardised
records.exact_reference: FoSCoS category 99.1, Nutra additives VA-VF—specific ingredient needed
established_source_facts: FoSCoS category denotes multiple nutraceutical permitted additives; a named substance is not supplied by the catalogue identity.
positive_additional_evidence: Exact legal Schedule VA–VF entry and version; name/INS/CAS.
Intended nutraceutical finished product and applicable use conditions.
Purity specification and formulation concentrations.
records.forbidden_inference: Do not transfer ordinary Appendix A commodity limits to an undetermined nutraceutical chemical.

records.product_name: Permitted enzymes and their preparations excluding those already listed under Processing Aids and Nutraceutical Regulations
established_source_facts: The FoSCoS title refers to a group of permitted enzyme preparations, not one enzyme article.
positive_additional_evidence: Enzyme name/EC code and declared activity.
Source production organism, recombinant status, carrier and additive identity.
Processing-aid versus ingredient classification, manufacturing use and purity evidence.
records.forbidden_inference: Do not infer an enzyme-specific residue/purity threshold from an unnamed preparation or from the food in which it is used.

records.product_name: Ingredients listed under Schedule IV, Schedule VI and Schedule VIII of Nutraceutical Regulations
records.exact_reference: FoSCoS 99.7 Nutraceutical Schedules IV, VI, VIII
established_source_facts: Schedule IV, VI and VIII collectively describe heterogeneous named ingredient classes, not one food identity.
positive_additional_evidence: Specific Schedule and clause/entry; source botanical/chemical taxon.
Extraction/standardisation method, active composition, grade and intended daily dose.
Applicable purity and contaminant schedule for identified ingredient and finished matrix.
records.forbidden_inference: Do not apply one botanical ingredient contaminant article to all scheduled nutraceutical ingredients.

records.exact_reference: FoSCoS category 99.7, mixtures/preparations/premix of functional ingredients
established_source_facts: Premix description does not specify a single finished-article substance or source crop.
positive_additional_evidence: Complete bill of materials with quantities, carriers and source identities.
Individual ingredient entries, process, intended use, target consumer group.
Combination and final matrix standard, lab results and applicable contaminant articles.
records.forbidden_inference: Do not multiply or inherit raw ingredient limits as finished-premix limits without an explicit legal rule.

records.exact_reference: FSSAI Ayurveda Aahara Compendium: Ksheera group 29.8, recipe PDF p.111 (zero-index 110); Ksh. Ku. chap.12 shloka 7–8
established_source_facts: FSSAI Compendium recipe identifies Narikela/Cocos nucifera endosperm (quantity sufficient) and Dugdha/milk (one part).
Classical preparation described as cooking coconut fleshy part in milk, cutting into small pieces.
Compendium indicates best use before within a day for the classical recipe.
Catalogue code 14.3 is not the Compendium's entry number 29.8; identity crosswalk must be verified.
positive_additional_evidence: Document actual coconut/milk ingredient ratios, finished process and target formulation correspondence.
Confirm Ayurveda Aahara Schedule A/B status, 2025 FSSAI category listing and packaging/shelf-life validation.
Check full governing Ayurveda Aahara contaminant Schedule D, not automatically raw milk lead.
records.forbidden_inference: Milk-containing coconut preparation cannot automatically inherit straight dairy milk CTR articles or be released solely on a classical recipe description.

records.exact_reference: FSSAI Ayurveda Aahara Compendium: Ksheera group 29.12, recipe PDF pp.114–115; Pa.Da.10/3–9
established_source_facts: Official Compendium recipe describes buffalo milk, aromatic flowers, water and sugar.
Classical preparation cooks milk and fragrant water, reduces, then adds sugar.
Compendium notes best use before within a day for the classical recipe.
Catalogue code 14.7 is not Compendium index 29.12 and requires identity crosswalk.
positive_additional_evidence: Confirm precise marketed recipe, botanical-flower identities, milk source and processing.
Confirm actual Ayurveda Aahara Schedule A/B classification, packaging and validated shelf-life.
Check all Ayurveda Aahara Schedule D contaminants separately from CTR milk article.
records.forbidden_inference: Ksheerapaka cannot inherit unverified pure-liquid-milk metal limits or use the recipe as a laboratory compliance result.
